title: kit.lead-forms.v1
description: A project's lead forms (src/forms.js FORMS): each form's label, the comms template that acknowledges it (<short prefix>.<form>.ack.v<n>) and its fields (key, label, required, max length; options and multiple for a select or a multi-select chip group), plus optional validate/params/enrich functions. The same fields GET /api/meta describes (kit.api-meta.v1) and POST /api/forms/<form> validates.

options.description: The only values the field accepts (a select, or a multi-select chip group).

multiple.description: A multi-select (chip group): the form posts a list of options; the lead keeps them joined with ", ".
